title: rhytidosolen laxus
intro: Rhytidosolen laxus, commonly known as the 'Slippery Thoroughwort', is a plant species in the family Asteraceae, native to Australia and New Zealand. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
